items.q: because he's trying to do something in regards to his father, Hugues Panassie.

ctx.x: I saw some of the movies he did of you and Milt Buckner in France and they were just amazing and I haven't seen anything like that here in the United States.

What Louis Panassie in France to do with this thing - he would like to come over to take it out to the colleges himself. He don't want to give it to nobody else because he wants it to be for educational purposes. He's going to do that. Other people would love to get it. I mean the networks such as CBS, NBC - they'd love to get it but he will not give it to them because he don't want it like that, because he's trying to do something in regards to his father, Hugues Panassie.
